summary: The bill expands the VA work-study program by allowing participants to perform any activity benefiting veterans at state, local, or nonprofit agencies, sets their minimum wage at the highest of federal, state, or local rates, requires electronic timesheet recording and approval, and mandates annual public reporting of participation data, wages, and hours starting in 2028.

scores.thoughts: The bill expands the scope of the VA Work-Study program by broadening eligible activities and raising the applicable minimum wage in many cases. These changes will increase federal expenditures on veterans' benefits starting in 2028, albeit modestly.
